content_md: I have some inklings for resisting Micro Time, yet undeveloped: **Re-Wiring** (changing the protocols), **Conversion** (translate between machine speed and human speed) and **Attunement** (syncing yourself to machine rhythms where it does not matter to create independence where it does matter).
